author: GerWynn
headline: An AI Lab Just Ran 11,000 Steps Alone — And Found a Cancer Mutation
text:
An AI Lab Just Ran 11,000 Steps Alone — And Found a Cancer Mutation

An AI-native laboratory called AutoDNA — seven AI agents coordinating more than 20 types of instruments — ran 11,000+ experimental steps with humans only restocking supplies, stored data in DNA and read it back exactly, and found and validated the KRAS G13D cancer mutation in a real tumour sample. Published in Nature, November 4, 2026, by Shanghai Jiao Tong University researchers. Early-stage research system — not a clinical test.

Primary source (Nature): https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11228-6
